Class declaration, constructor, static Current accessor with null-safe ?. operator, instance fields/methods, lock objects, and ExposeData with preserved Scribe keys all implemented correctly. issues.description: Residual DatingManager.Current.ExposeData() call. Before the conversion, DatingManager was static and this MapComponent call was the ONLY way its data got serialized. Now that DatingManager is a GameComponent, the engine calls ExposeData() automatically at the game level. This line causes double serialization — 'dates' and 'dateCooldowns' are written to both the GameComponent and MapComponent XML sections. On load, the MapComponent call overwrites data already loaded by the GameComponent. For old saves (pre-conversion), this accidentally provides backward compatibility since the data only exists in the MapComponent section. Should be removed once save migration is considered, or replaced with a one-time migration.

sharedStateObservations.observation: When converting a static class to GameComponent, any existing MapComponent that previously proxied the static class's ExposeData() must have that call REMOVED, since GameComponent.ExposeData() is called automatically by the engine. This cleanup step is not mentioned in the refactor-worker skill's 'class conversion' procedure or in AGENTS.md conventions.
